title: 冬の切り絵フレーム
lead: 雪の結晶・ヒイラギ・椿・南天・星空など、冬のモチーフを切り絵風に描いたフレーム12点です。おたより・カード・写真の枠に使えます。
subject_en: Decorative frames/borders with an EMPTY centre filled with plain white so it becomes transparent; each frame is ONE separate piece centred in its cell, landscape or square, thick enough to hold text or a photo, decorated with the motifs of the theme. Layered paper-cut style. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: frame made of large paper-cut snowflakes in pale blue and white-cream
frame of holly leaves and red berries
frame of red camellia flowers and dark green leaves
frame of nandina branches with red berries
frame of dark blue night sky with stars and a crescent moon
